name: Following Up Politely
equipment: A notebook and a colleague or mirror to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on following up politely -- practice these key phrases out loud:
Just following up on my email from last week.
I wanted to check in on the status of this request.
Apologies for the follow-up -- did you get a chance to look at this?
No rush, just wanted to keep this on your radar.
Try using at least two of these phrases in a short role-play scenario at work.
